name: motion-settle-drop
title: Settle Drop
description: Khối nặng rơi xuống, lún bẹp sâu 145 / 62 % rồi từ từ trở lại hình dạng, không nảy, bụi tung hai bên.

credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio settle-drop, written here): Fall y −110 → 0 (demo −94 px) in 320 ms power1.in, stretching to scaleY 1.1 / scaleX 1/1.1 at contact; it then squashes over 60 ms (power2.out) to scaleX 1.45 / scaleY 0.62 (origin bottom) and recovers to 1/1 in 550 ms power2.out with no overshoot (heavy); dust dots puff 14–41 px beyond each side over 500 ms; shadow widens. Params: drop (110 px) · squash (1.45 / 0.62) · squash_in (0.06 s) · recover (0.55 s).
moworks.titleVi: Rơi nặng, lún sâu, từ từ đứng lên
